objective: Execute final acceptance: re-run the evidence commands for contract acceptance A1-A6 on the closed system and write the acceptance results table that closes the Stage

concepts: no-waiver rule (a failing item stops the Stage)

allowed_dependencies.what: unit evidence for A1 row assertions

non_goals: No code changes of any kind — this task only runs evidence and records results
No new criteria, no waivers, no 'close enough' — a failing A-item stops the Stage
implementation_constraints: Re-run the exact evidence commands named in stage-contract.json acceptance (no substitutes)
Write the results table {A1..A6: pass/fail + command + output excerpt} into the checkpoint

acceptance_tests.description: all six evidence commands re-run: results.json records A1-A6 each as pass with the command and an output excerpt
acceptance_tests.evidence: tests/acceptance/results.json contains 6 entries, all pass, each with command + excerpt

acceptance_tests.description: if any A-item fails, the results table marks it failed with the failing command and the checkpoint stops (no waiver, no re-run beyond the 3-strike gate_failure rule)
acceptance_tests.evidence: results.json entry for the failing item is pass=false; checkpoint T08 status is blocked

failure_cases.scenario: an evidence command errors for environmental reasons (fixture missing, DB unavailable)
failure_cases.expected_behavior: the results table records it as an environment failure (not an acceptance failure) with the exact error output; V1: stop and report to the user rather than waiving

handoff.notes: this is the Stage-closing checkpoint — remaining_dag is empty and downstream_notes carry the acceptance verdict for the orchestrator

warnings.detail: re-runs acceptance evidence A1-A6 covering C1-C6
warnings.rationale: final acceptance is read-only evidence collection; no implementation context is loaded
